description: Pure C runtime and capnpc-c plugin for Cap'n Proto. Wire encode is byte-equivalent with official capnp 1.0.2 when objects are allocated in schema order. Maintained HaoZeke fork of the unmaintained opensourcerouting/c-capnproto lineage.
rules: Use HaoZeke/c-capnproto, not the unmaintained opensourcerouting or jmckaskill trees.
Allocate and set struct fields in schema declaration order for C++ / official capnp encode byte parity.
Call capn_set_root before capn_write_mem; omitting it writes an empty message.
Failed pointer hops are CAPN_NULL. Check capn_ok. This is not C++ MessageReader throw-parity.
Packed 0xFF follows the C++ PackedOutputStream heuristic. Empty struct list element B is -1.
Prefer Meson (meson setup build && meson compile -C build). Sibling runtimes: capnp-fortran and capnp-janet.
